Finance · Batch B: the shared refusal words, the failed-Undo bar with Retry, the shared back link

Real screenshots of the preview (fake data). Amber outline = what changed. No design choice is open: this shows what was decided (v1.045 (4), v1.048 (12), v1.051) now built.

1 · A refused change (R2-07) someone else changed it first: nothing was done, their change is shown

Daily report — the amber bar on the page (here: Undo of Close the day, after another admin reopened the day)

Before “Someone else changed this just now. Your change wasn't saved.”

After “Someone else changed the day just now, so nothing was done. Their change is shown.”

Close the day box — the amber line inside the box (the day's payments changed while it was open); same sentence

Before “Someone else changed this just now. Your change wasn't saved.”

After “Someone else changed the day just now, so nothing was done. Their change is shown.”

Settings — names “the setting”

Before “Someone else changed this just now. Your change wasn't saved.”

After “Someone else changed the setting just now, so nothing was done. Their change is shown.”

2 · A failed Undo (R2-07) the connection dropped while Undo ran: the bar says so and offers Retry

Daily report — Undo of Close the day failed (preview: failNextSave)

Before “Couldn't undo. Check the connection, then try again. (no Retry button)”

After “Undo didn't save. Check the connection, then retry. + Retry”

Settings — Undo of a reminder change failed

Before “Couldn't save. Check the connection, then try again. (the generic settings-save-failed sentence; no Retry for the Undo)”

After “Undo didn't save. Check the connection, then retry. + Retry”
